name: OmniSight
description: It is a monitoring platform that allows you to monitor multiple platforms on a single page.

paragraphs: A simple, single-glance monitoring dashboard for Proxmox, VMware ESXi/vCenter, Linux servers, Kubernetes, SNMP devices, Docker, Dockhand, firewalls, TrueNAS/QNAP/UGREEN storage, Proxmox Backup Server, Portainer, databases, built-in service checks, Healthchecks, Uptime Kuma and Prometheus.
Try the hosted live demo with username demo and password demo.
features: Modern UI — fully redesigned interface: glass header, soft-glow status indicators, card-grid summaries, draggable/collapsible dashboard cards, compact platform summaries in detail headers, Inter typography, refined dark…
Topology — relationship map for platforms, hosts and workloads

One agent, one command — Linux servers, Windows hosts, Proxmox nodes and Docker hosts can be monitored by a small push agent. In Settings just click + Add System / Windows Host / Node / Host, copy the pre-filled…

Proxmox — node CPU/RAM/temperature/uptime, Disk I/O and bandwidth when exposed by the API, agent or optional SSH metrics fallback, VM/LXC lists with clickable detail views, per-node service status with…

VMware ESXi / vCenter — standalone ESXi and vCenter discovery through the vSphere Web Services API, including datacenters, clusters, host connection/maintenance health, CPU/RAM/uptime, virtual machines, guest…

whatItDoes.text: A simple, single-glance monitoring dashboard for Proxmox, VMware ESXi/vCenter, Linux servers, Kubernetes, SNMP devices, Docker, Dockhand, firewalls, TrueNAS/QNAP/UGREEN storage, Proxmox Backup Server, Portainer, databases, built-in service checks, Healthchecks, Uptime Kuma and Prometheus.

requirements.text: Use a scoped API token with Zone Read; tunnel health needs an account ID and tunnel read access, while domain expiration needs Cloudflare Registrar read access.
Dashboard: — the app starts with no config; set up your account and configure platforms from the Settings UI.
firewall — one or more gateway instances[] with name, type (opnsense or pfsense compatible API), url, API key/secret or username/password and optional insecureTLS
truenas — one or more storage instances[] with name, url, apiMode: auto | websocket | rest, username, API key/password and optional insecureTLS
